title: Bears & Commanders Lose Their QBs & Some Surprising 0-2 Teams
channel_name: The MMQB NFL Podcast
text: Conor Orr and Albert Breer break down how the Bears and Commanders will respond after losing Caleb Williams and Jayden Daniels to major injuries before getting into the Browns’ huge upset win over the Buccaneers, who join the Chargers and Texans as winless contending teams. title: Week 2 Recap: Bengals, Saints, Broncos score big wins on weird Sunday

text: Need more proof that the NFL is a week-to-week league? Well, after tying the record for most points scored in Week 1 to kick off the season, scoring came all the way back down to earth in Week 2. The day was further dampened by injuries to Caleb Williams and Jayden Daniels. Still, there were some big winners, across the league. Such as the Cincinnati Bengals, who rode their defense—yes, defense—to beat the Houston Texans. And how about the New Orleans Saints, who upset the Baltimore Ravens on the road.
